Game Overview

Nikosan Quest is a adventure title where guide Nikosan through a vibrant universe in this thrilling 2D platformer. Collect yellow cubes and dodge relentless hazards like spikes, monsters, and blades. Master your double jump for deft obstacle navigation to reach the victorious flag. Can you conquer all eight increasingly difficult levels?
